inventory.note: The complete original inventory is preserved byte for byte after decompression. It contains all enumeration records, file lists, commit subjects, evidence, maintenance, risks, and collection methods.

issues.discussion_query: repository.discussions with bodies, comments and replies; all pageInfo.hasNextPage false.
issues.pagination: gh api --paginate --slurp for both REST endpoints; pull_request records removed from issue inventory.
issues.inclusion_rule: Scan every issue body and every comment for code blocks, indented code, inline expressions, gist/patch attachments and implementation links. Assess concrete fixes, prototypes and algorithm proposals. Retain all issues in inventory; support-only tracebacks/usage samples do not establish reusable code.
issues.not_reproduced: No external patch, model, audio or benchmark was executed. Repository source checks confirm selected duplicate fixes only.

recommendations.adopt as-is: A narrow patch is suitable for unchanged adoption after normal integration checks. This report does not merge it.
recommendations.adapt: Reuse selected design or code after stated API, licence and validation work.
recommendations.idea only: Research/reference value; insufficient permission, parity or maturity for code adoption.
recommendations.ignore: No useful outstanding change, a duplicate, a regression, or unrelated work.

definitions.licensing: Source, models and datasets can have different licences. API NOASSERTION is not evidence of no licence. A public issue snippet does not imply a reuse grant.
definitions.maintenance: Dates and stars are snapshot evidence. Recent pushes, stars and successful build jobs do not prove runtime correctness or long-term maintenance.

catalogue_scope: Contains every candidate, unmerged PR, Discussion, source-reviewed ahead default fork, and separately source-reviewed extra branch. Other branch records and support-only issues remain in the complete inventory. Recommendation reasons do not replace the evidence, risks, or validation requirements in that inventory and the Markdown report.

adoption_priorities.scope: Replace numpy.math INFINITY imports with libc.math in both extensions.
adoption_priorities.why: The baseline still imports the deprecated Cython numpy.math include; clean builds failed with Cython 3.1, and libc.math removes that dependency. The PR author reports that Cython 3.1.2 fixed the immediate include failure.
adoption_priorities.acceptance: Build with supported Python/NumPy/Cython versions and run existing HMM/CRF tests.

adoption_priorities.scope: Package 2019 TCN models; use setuptools.Extension; isolate legacy pickle dtype compatibility.
adoption_priorities.why: Preserve installed CLI/model loading on current Python and NumPy.
adoption_priorities.acceptance: Inspect built wheel contents; load each model family and CLI from the installed wheel; test old pickle align encodings. Do not import tests as package assets.

adoption_priorities.scope: Correct swapped phase and tempo tolerances in beat continuity evaluation.
adoption_priorities.why: Unequal documented tolerances currently produce the wrong score.
adoption_priorities.acceptance: Keep added asymmetric regression tests and upstream evaluation tests; record the corrected nondefault scoring behavior.

adoption_priorities.scope: Fix the missing online keyword default, explicit process-pool ownership and channel-mix inconsistency.
adoption_priorities.why: Improve direct processor use and repeated inference without API changes.
adoption_priorities.acceptance: Test omitted kwargs, repeated construction/cleanup, caller-owned pools, and decoder/channel parity. Repair the undefined variable in #505.

adoption_priorities.scope: Evaluate GIL release and optional inference backends against the current processor outputs.
adoption_priorities.why: Reuse narrow optimizations and tracked numerical fixtures before replacing core inference.
adoption_priorities.acceptance: Compare features, activations and decoded events for all model families; preserve legacy pickle loading and current defaults; measure concurrent latency and memory.

adoption_priorities.scope: Evaluate the Rust offline DBN core and bounded causal streaming interface separately.
adoption_priorities.why: Existing native implementations can reduce duplicate work, but they implement different model/decoder scopes.
adoption_priorities.acceptance: Track lawful nonempty parity fixtures; test reset/chunk boundaries, event timestamps and bounded memory; build CI alone is insufficient.

adoption_priorities.scope: Extract compatible streaming state/reset tests, block filtering, tempo-buffer fixes and opt-in meter priors. Use #333 only as a design reference.
adoption_priorities.why: Historical madmom work already covers much of the required processor design.
adoption_priorities.acceptance: Compare chunked with frame processing; preserve positional constructor APIs and upstream tests; reject invalid prior vectors and test empty input.

adoption_priorities.scope: Compare causal particle filters, compact state spaces and streaming neural models as optional processors.
adoption_priorities.why: Published algorithms provide stronger online baselines than an offline model in a rolling window.
adoption_priorities.acceptance: Resolve licence scope; compare event accuracy, continuity, octave errors, warm-up and capture-to-event delay on held-out audio.

adoption_priorities.scope: Prototype robust period estimation with octave preference, circular phase and beat-grid regression.
adoption_priorities.why: Use a long stable beat grid to reduce interval jitter and test octave ambiguity explicitly.
adoption_priorities.acceptance: Implement independently or obtain script permission; make tempo-range folding opt-in; test outliers, missing/duplicate beats, few events, silence, tempo drift and held-out genres against median/trimmed-mean baselines.

entries.author: Georgi Dzhambazov
entries.changes: Add a joint bar/note hidden state model, GMM observation models, and note-aware pattern-tracking commands.
entries.reason: Use the joint-state design for research; a general maintained processor requires a new implementation and evaluation.

entries.changes: Add one merge commit with no changed files relative to its merge base.
entries.reason: An ahead commit count alone does not show a useful change.

entries.author: SebastianPoell
entries.changes: Add online comb-filter, autocorrelation, and DBN tempo estimation plus online beat processing and reset support.
entries.reason: Treat this as historical design and test provenance; check for a missing behavior before adding another online tempo API.

entries.author: Greg Friedland
entries.changes: Add online spectral flux and per-frequency-band onset output.
entries.reason: An optional band-onset processor can be useful, but preserve the existing processor and CLI semantics.

entries.reason: The old parser was replaced and this patch can introduce an exception.

entries.reason: Use the current isolated pyproject.toml build instead of restoring legacy setup_requires hooks.

entries.author: Björn Lindqvist
entries.changes: Simplify CLI file arguments, remove audio file-handle support and decoding helpers, and change evaluation behavior.
entries.reason: This conflicts with backward compatibility and test-preservation requirements.

entries.author: Sandi Chakravarty
entries.changes: Add blockwise magnitude STFT/filterbank processing, filter scaling processors, tempo interpolation, and meter priors.
entries.reason: Separate the optional log meter prior from the STFT optimization; retain defaults and benchmark each change.

entries.author: beauburrows
entries.changes: Add OSC output from DBN beat tracking and supporting documentation.
entries.reason: Keep transport output in an optional wrapper and exclude build artifacts.

entries.author: Sebastian Böck
entries.changes: Add MIDIFile.key_signatures, a structured array of event time and key, with a C-major default at time zero.
entries.reason: This is additive and useful; add tests for missing keys, key changes, minor keys, and time units.

entries.author: Larry Fenn
entries.changes: Add WASAPI input selection, native-rate stream handling, and a RawPcmStream input path.
entries.reason: Only the raw-PCM input and explicit stream-selection concepts merit a compatible optional implementation.

entries.author: Jaro Väisänen
entries.changes: Add drum-specific CNN onset processors and a CLI with separate frequency ranges.
entries.reason: Use as a feature-design experiment; require actual drum labels, matching training, and evaluation.

entries.author: Paul Kanyuk
entries.changes: Add MIDI onset output, custom recurrent-layer experiments, and a custom model submodule.
entries.reason: An explicit output processor can implement MIDI triggers without import-time I/O or a model switch.

entries.changes: Guard empty decoded paths and change non-beat observation likelihood to use one activation column.
entries.reason: The empty-path fix is already present; do not change the observation distribution without an evaluated model rationale.

entries.reason: No adoption candidate for the three implementation lanes.

entries.reason: The final behavior breaks model assumptions and existing public output formats.
